p1-upper-player-placement.reason: Actual upper player is drawn 20 logical pixels left of the source while all 254 compared simulation bytes match after 17 callbacks. The coloured sprite silhouette is an exact horizontal translation; the native sprite origin uses $6c where this viewport requires $80. No fix is applied.

p1-moving-prefix.reason: Completed-frame source-generation comparison exposes the same 20-pixel native sprite-origin defect as p1-upper-player-placement. All compared simulation bytes match at every retained callback; source images are associated by captured hardware state, not native visual similarity. Later moving checks remain visible in the case report.

p2-first-serve-pitch.reason: Actual AUD3PER is 1687 for captured SN76489A tone divisor 213. The nearest integral Paula period is 1688 using the stock PAL 3546895 Hz clock and four-sample waveform. Native conversion uses 507/64=7.921875 instead of 3546895*8/3579545=7.927029832. Captured native WAV is consistent with the written period; source state and PSG bytes match. No waveform tolerance is inferred and no product correction is applied.

p2-first-serve-envelope.reason: At serve attenuation 14, the recorded source plateau amplitude is 326 relative to 8191 at full volume, stable under 2/3/4 ms trims. Its nearest 0-64 Paula level is 3; the native table writes 2. The other 14 measured decay levels agree. Source state and PSG sequence match; pitch is compared separately. No product fix is applied.
p2-first-serve-envelope.evidence: tests/cases/p2-first-serve-envelope.json; build/tests/p2-first-serve-envelope-report.json; private source WAV; amiga/paula_tone_output.s paula_volume_table
